name: Wolf
section: Track 1, DM Appendix and Emerald Enclave reinforcement
sourceWitness: Local Wizards of the Coast V2 with printed folios. The publisher index confirms the adventure code and title.
errataEvidence: No correction for this block was located in the publisher’s errata index or Adventurers League adaptation guide.
habitatEvidence: Tags follow the encounter setting and are editorial.
appearanceEvidence: Printed p. 37 specifies studded leather barding. The portrait depicts the armor and leaves the printed weapon anomaly to the rules notes.
mechanicsNotes: The visually verified Wolf column on p. 37 contains Scimitar as its only action. This appears to be a copying error, since the adventure calls it a wolf mount and gives it no weapon. The staged stat block retains the printed action.
The standard 2014 Monster Manual Wolf p. 341 has Bite. That separate source does not revise this adventure.
variant: Adventure Wolf mount with studded leather barding, AC 14.

name: Young Bulette (Rhinoceros)

sourceWitness: Local Wizards of the Coast V2 with printed folios. The publisher index confirms the adventure code and title.
errataEvidence: No correction for this block was located in the publisher’s errata index or Adventurers League adaptation guide.

appearanceEvidence: The encounter on p. 47 calls them young bulettes with opalescent eyes. The portrait uses a juvenile bulette silhouette.
